risks.title: Dependence on electric transition and HV volume volatility
risks.score_rationale: Major risk explicitly detailed: high-voltage activity down 43% (-€334M vs H1 2023), described as penalized by the decline of certain EV platforms in Europe. Intensive language: 'unfavorable basis', 'decline'. Trend: up (deteriorating). Critical weight: €513M HV sales out of €5,692M POWER (9%), with negative impact of -7 points on performance vs production.

risks.title: Customer concentration and portfolio repositioning in China
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk: 70% of H1 2024 order intake from Chinese OEMs (excluding JVs), with -7 point underperformance vs local production. Language: 'repositioning of customer portfolio' indicates strategic volatility. Trend: stable but structural. Weight: China = 14% of OE sales (€1,266M), key region for EV growth.

risks.title: Technology risk and competitiveness in ADAS and autonomous vehicles
risks.score_rationale: Growing business risk: BRAIN Division shows +6% OE and +7% ADAS, but depends on intensive R&D capabilities (€1,079M R&D H1 2024, +8% vs H1 2023). Language: '90% of new vehicles by 2030' indicates major strategic stakes. Trend: up (accelerating). Weight: BRAIN = 23% of sales, margin 15.9%.

risks.title: Exposure to production cycles and new model launches
risks.score_rationale: Structural business risk: 'Miscellaneous' sales (tooling, customer R&D) +30% LFL reflect dependence on future launches. Language: 'very large number of future new production launches' indicates volatility. Trend: up (accelerating launches). Weight: impact on production capacity and cash flow.

risks.title: Competitiveness risk in LED lighting and EV design
risks.score_rationale: Specific business risk LIGHT: division shows +1% sales but stable margin of 12.7% despite 'high costs involved in preparing for numerous production launches'. Language: 'LED technology' and 'high-definition light beams' indicate technology race. Trend: stable. Weight: LIGHT = 26% of sales (€2,853M).

risks.title: Supply chain dependence and raw material cost exposure
risks.score_rationale: Implicit risk: gross margin improved by 'good control over operations' but exposed to 'continued wage growth' (mentioned). Language: lack of supply chain detail indicates unmitigated risk. Trend: stable but structural. Weight: production costs critical for margins (4.0% operating margin).

risks.title: Risk of overcapacity and continued industrial restructuring
risks.score_rationale: Business risk: €500M asset divestiture plan underway, Thermal/Powertrain Systems merger (April 2024) with €100M annual synergies, €44M H1 2024 restructuring costs. Language: 'exceptional cost reduction measures' indicates urgency. Trend: up (accelerating restructuring). Weight: impact on capacity and employment.

risks.title: Geographic risk: underperformance in Europe and Japan
risks.score_rationale: Regional business risk: Europe -3% LFL (49% of OE sales), Japan affected by 'production stoppages at several Japanese automakers'. Language: 'sluggish business levels' indicates fragility. Trend: stable but structural. Weight: Europe + Japan = ~35% of OE sales.
